subject: maths
title: Place Value to 1000: Hundreds, Tens and Ones
seo_title: Year 2 Place Value Worksheets: Numbers to 1000, Free with Answer Key
standard_text: Partition, rearrange, regroup and rename two- and three-digit numbers using standard and non-standard groupings; recognise the role of zero in place value notation
meta_desc: Free Year 2 place value maths worksheets for the Australian Curriculum: hundreds, tens and ones with MAB, the value of each digit, zero as a place holder, standard and non-standard partitioning, and comparing and ordering numbers to 1000. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: The place of a digit tells you its value. The 4 in 345 is worth 40.
key_sub: Write 0 for an empty place: three hundred and five is 305, not 35 or 3005. 346 is 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 6 ones, or 2 hundreds, 14 tens and 6 ones.
body_html:
Hundreds, tens and ones

A 3-digit number has three places: hundreds, tens and ones. 10 ones make 1 ten. 10 tens make 1 hundred. 10 hundreds make 1000.

The value of a digit

The place tells you what a digit is worth.

Zero holds a place

If a place is empty, write 0 there. The 0 keeps the other digits in the right places.

Write in numerals

Write “three hundred and five” in numerals.

3 hundreds, 0 tens, 5 ones. Write 3, 0, 5.

Answer: 305 (not 35 or 3005)

Partition in different ways

The standard way uses each digit: 346 = 300 + 40 + 6. A non-standard way trades 1 hundred for 10 tens.

Partition

Partition 346 in two ways.

Standard: 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 6 ones. Non-standard: 2 hundreds, 14 tens and 6 ones.

Answer: 300 + 40 + 6 = 200 + 140 + 6

Compare and order

First count the digits: a 3-digit number is bigger than a 2-digit number. If both have 3 digits, compare the hundreds, then the tens, then the ones.

Compare

452 ☐ 425

Hundreds: 4 = 4. Tens: 5 tens > 2 tens.

Answer: 452 > 425

> means “is greater than”. < means “is less than”. The open side faces the bigger number.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Writing each part you hear (three hundred and five = 3005)A hundreds number has 3 digits: 305
Leaving out the zero (305 = 35)Write 0 for the empty tens place: 305
Giving the digit, not its value (the 4 in 345 is 4)The 4 is in the tens place: 40
Writing 14 tens inside the number (2 hundreds, 14 tens, 6 ones = 2146)14 tens = 140, so 200 + 140 + 6 = 346
Comparing the first digits only (98 > 102)Count the digits first: 102 > 98

faq.q: What place value does a Year 2 student learn in Australia?
faq.a: The Australian Curriculum (AC9M2N02) asks Year 2 students to partition, rearrange, regroup and rename two- and three-digit numbers and to understand the role of zero. They also order numbers to at least 1000 (AC9M2N01).

MAB (multi-base arithmetic blocks) are the base-ten blocks used in Australian classrooms: a mini is 1, a long is 10 and a flat is 100. Children build numbers with them to see what each digit is worth.

faq.q: Why is zero important in place value?
faq.a: Zero holds an empty place so the other digits keep their value. Without it, 305 would become 35, so children learn to write 0 when there are no tens or no ones.

It means splitting a number in a way other than hundreds, tens and ones digits. For example, 346 can be 2 hundreds, 14 tens and 6 ones, which helps children trade and regroup when they add and subtract.

sets.title: Hundreds, tens and ones with MAB

items.e: A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 2 hundreds, 3 tens and 4 ones make 234. Start with the flats, then the longs, then the minis.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 1 hundred, 5 tens and 2 ones make 152. Start with the flats, then the longs, then the minis.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 3 hundreds, 2 tens and 6 ones make 326. Start with the flats, then the longs, then the minis.
Each long is 1 ten. There are 5 longs, so there are 5 tens. The number is 352.
Each flat is 1 hundred. There are 4 flats, so there are 4 hundreds. The number is 426.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 2 hundreds, 8 tens and 5 ones make 285. Start with the flats, then the longs, then the minis.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 4 hundreds, 1 ten and 7 ones make 417. Start with the flats, then the longs, then the minis.
Count each kind: 3 flats, 6 longs, 4 minis. That is 3 hundreds, 6 tens and 4 ones: 364.
Count each kind: 2 flats, 5 longs, 7 minis. That is 2 hundreds, 5 tens and 7 ones: 257.
Each mini is 1 one. There are 8 minis, so there are 8 ones. The number is 278.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 1 hundred, 7 tens and 9 ones make 179. Start with the flats, then the longs, then the minis.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 1 one make 341. Start with the flats, then the longs, then the minis.
Count each kind: 5 flats, 1 long, 8 minis. That is 5 hundreds, 1 ten and 8 ones: 518.

items.q: Which number has 4 hundreds, 2 tens and 9 ones?
items.e: Write the hundreds digit first, then the tens, then the ones: 4, 2, 9. That is 429.

items.q: Which number has 7 hundreds, 3 tens and 1 one?
items.e: Write the hundreds digit first, then the tens, then the ones: 7, 3, 1. That is 731.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 5 hundreds, 6 tens and 3 ones make 563. Start with the flats, then the longs, then the minis.
The MAB show 245. A long is 10. 245 + 10 = 255. Only the tens digit changes.
The MAB show 136. A flat is 100. 136 + 100 = 236. Only the hundreds digit changes.
The MAB show 359. Add 1 mini: now there are 10 minis. Trade 10 minis for 1 long. That is 3 hundreds, 6 tens and 0 ones: 360.

items.q: Which number has 6 hundreds, 8 tens and 2 ones?
items.e: Write the hundreds digit first, then the tens, then the ones: 6, 8, 2. That is 682.
Count the longs in tens: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60. 6 tens = 60.

items.q: What is the red digit worth?
items.e: The red 4 is in the tens place. It is worth 4 tens = 40. The digit is 4, but its value is 40.

items.q: What is the red digit worth?
items.e: The red 5 is in the hundreds place. It is worth 5 hundreds = 500. The digit is 5, but its value is 500.

items.q: What is the 7 in 473 worth?
items.e: The 7 is in the tens place. It is worth 7 tens = 70. The digit is 7, but its value is 70.

items.q: In 736, which digit is in the hundreds place?
items.e: 736 is 7 hundreds, 3 tens and 6 ones. The hundreds digit is 7. (Its value is 700.)
Count the flats in hundreds: 100, 200, 300 … 800. 8 hundreds = 800.

items.q: What is the red digit worth?
items.e: The red 6 is in the ones place. It is worth 6 ones = 6.

items.q: What is the red digit worth?
items.e: The red 9 is in the tens place. It is worth 9 tens = 90. The digit is 9, but its value is 90.

items.q: Which number has a 6 in the tens place?
items.e: 263 is 2 hundreds, 6 tens and 3 ones. The 6 is in the tens place.

items.q: What is the 6 in 619 worth?
items.e: The 6 is in the hundreds place. It is worth 6 hundreds = 600. The digit is 6, but its value is 600.

items.q: What is the 8 in 538 worth?
items.e: The 8 is in the ones place. It is worth 8 ones = 8.

items.q: In 418, which digit is in the tens place?
items.e: 418 is 4 hundreds, 1 ten and 8 ones. The tens digit is 1. (Its value is 10.)
Count the longs in tens: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. 5 tens = 50.

items.q: What is the red digit worth?
items.e: The red 2 is in the hundreds place. It is worth 2 hundreds = 200. The digit is 2, but its value is 200.

items.q: What is the red digit worth?
items.e: The red 5 is in the tens place. It is worth 5 tens = 50. The digit is 5, but its value is 50.

items.q: Which number has an 8 in the hundreds place?
items.e: 815 is 8 hundreds, 1 ten and 5 ones. The 8 is in the hundreds place.

items.q: What is the 2 in 924 worth?
items.e: The 2 is in the tens place. It is worth 2 tens = 20. The digit is 2, but its value is 20.

items.q: What is the 7 in 751 worth?
items.e: The 7 is in the hundreds place. It is worth 7 hundreds = 700. The digit is 7, but its value is 700.

items.q: In 695, which digit is in the tens place?
items.e: 695 is 6 hundreds, 9 tens and 5 ones. The tens digit is 9. (Its value is 90.)

items.q: Which number has a 3 in the ones place?
items.e: 473 is 4 hundreds, 7 tens and 3 ones. The 3 is in the ones place.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 3 hundreds, 0 tens and 5 ones make 305. There are no tens, so write 0 in the tens place.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 4 hundreds, 6 tens and 0 ones make 460. There are no ones, so write 0 in the ones place.

items.q: Write “four hundred and six” in numerals.
items.e: Four hundred and six is 4 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones: 406. Write 0 for the empty tens place. The 0 keeps the other digits in the right places.

items.q: Write “two hundred and three” in numerals.
items.e: Two hundred and three is 2 hundreds, 0 tens and 3 ones: 203. Write 0 for the empty tens place. The 0 keeps the other digits in the right places.

items.q: How many tens are in 507?
items.e: 507 is 5 hundreds, 0 tens and 7 ones. The 0 shows there are no tens.

items.q: What number do the MAB show?
items.e: A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 2 hundreds, 0 tens and 8 ones make 208. There are no tens, so write 0 in the tens place.

items.q: What is 600 + 7?
items.e: 600 + 7 is 6 hundreds, 0 tens and 7 ones: 607. Do not write 600 then 7. The answer has only 3 digits.

items.q: Which number has 0 tens?
items.e: 306 is 3 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones. 360 and 630 have 0 ones, and 36 has 3 tens.

items.q: Write “five hundred and seventy” in numerals.
items.e: Five hundred and seventy is 5 hundreds, 7 tens and 0 ones: 570. Write 0 for the empty ones place. The 0 keeps the other digits in the right places.

items.q: How many ones are in 380?
items.e: 380 is 3 hundreds, 8 tens and 0 ones. The 0 shows there are no ones.
A flat is 100, a long is 10 and a mini is 1. 7 hundreds, 0 tens and 0 ones make 700. There are no tens or ones, so write 0 in the tens and ones places.

items.q: How do you write 708 in words?
items.e: 708 is 7 hundreds, 0 tens and 8 ones. Say the hundreds, then the ones: seven hundred and eight.

items.q: What is 400 + 90?
items.e: 400 + 90 is 4 hundreds, 9 tens and 0 ones: 490. Do not write 400 then 90. The answer has only 3 digits.

items.q: Which number has 0 ones?
items.e: 470 is 4 hundreds, 7 tens and 0 ones. 407 and 704 have 0 tens, and 47 has 7 ones.

items.q: Write “eight hundred and nine” in numerals.
items.e: Eight hundred and nine is 8 hundreds, 0 tens and 9 ones: 809. Write 0 for the empty tens place. The 0 keeps the other digits in the right places.

items.q: Oliver writes 3005 for “three hundred and five”. What should he write?
items.e: Three hundred and five is 3 hundreds, 0 tens and 5 ones: 305. 3005 has 4 digits. It is far too big.

items.q: How do you write 350 in words?
items.e: 350 is 3 hundreds, 5 tens and 0 ones. 5 tens is fifty, not fifteen: three hundred and fifty.

items.q: What is 800 + 3?
items.e: 800 + 3 is 8 hundreds, 0 tens and 3 ones: 803. Do not write 800 then 3. The answer has only 3 digits.

items.q: Write “six hundred and forty” in numerals.
items.e: Six hundred and forty is 6 hundreds, 4 tens and 0 ones: 640. Write 0 for the empty ones place. The 0 keeps the other digits in the right places.

items.q: Which is true?
items.e: 305 has 3 digits and 35 has only 2. 305 is 3 hundreds and 5 ones. 35 is 3 tens and 5 ones. So 305 > 35. The 0 matters.

sets.title: Partition in standard and non-standard ways

items.q: Which shows 346 split into hundreds, tens and ones?
items.e: 346 is 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 6 ones. That is 300 + 40 + 6.

items.q: Which shows 572 split into hundreds, tens and ones?
items.e: 572 is 5 hundreds, 7 tens and 2 ones. That is 500 + 70 + 2.

items.q: 300 + ☐ + 6 = 346. What number goes in the box?
items.e: 346 is 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 6 ones. 4 tens = 40.

items.q: ☐ + 20 + 9 = 829. What number goes in the box?
items.e: 829 is 8 hundreds, 2 tens and 9 ones. 8 hundreds = 800.

items.q: Which shows 508 split into parts?
items.e: 508 is 5 hundreds, 0 tens and 8 ones. 0 tens adds nothing. So 508 = 500 + 8.

items.q: Which shows 690 split into parts?
items.e: 690 is 6 hundreds, 9 tens and 0 ones. 9 tens = 90. So 690 = 600 + 90.

items.q: 400 + ☐ = 407. What number goes in the box?
items.e: 407 is 4 hundreds, 0 tens and 7 ones. 400 + 7 = 407.

items.q: 600 + 30 + ☐ = 635. What number goes in the box?
items.e: 635 is 6 hundreds, 3 tens and 5 ones. The ones part is 5.
There are 14 longs. 10 longs make 1 hundred, so 14 tens = 1 hundred and 4 tens. 200 + 140 + 6 = 346.

items.q: 346 = 2 hundreds, ☐ tens and 6 ones. What number goes in the box?
items.e: Take 1 hundred from 3 hundreds and make it 10 tens. Now there are 2 hundreds and 10 + 4 = 14 tens. Check: 200 + 140 + 6 = 346.
12 longs are 12 tens = 120. 100 + 120 + 5 = 225. That is the same as 2 hundreds, 2 tens and 5 ones.

items.q: 523 = 4 hundreds, 12 tens and ☐ ones. What number goes in the box?
items.e: 4 hundreds = 400 and 12 tens = 120. 400 + 120 = 520. 523 − 520 = 3. So there are 3 ones.

items.q: Which is another way to make 346?
items.e: 2 hundreds = 200 and 14 tens = 140. 200 + 140 + 6 = 346. (The others make 246, 446 and 356.)

items.q: What number do the MAB show?
items.e: 15 minis are 1 ten and 5 ones. 300 + 15 = 315.

items.q: Which is not equal to 250?
How many tens are in 250 altogether?
items.e: 250 = 2 hundreds and 5 tens. 2 hundreds = 20 tens. 20 tens + 5 tens = 25 tens.

items.q: 430 = ☐ tens. What number goes in the box?
items.e: 430 = 4 hundreds and 3 tens. 4 hundreds = 40 tens. 40 + 3 = 43 tens. Check: 43 × 10 = 430.

items.q: 600 = ☐ tens. What number goes in the box?
items.e: 1 hundred = 10 tens. 6 hundreds = 60 tens. Check: 60 × 10 = 600.

items.q: 357 = 200 + ☐ + 7. What number goes in the box?
items.e: 357 = 300 + 50 + 7. Only 200 is used, so 100 moves to the tens part: 100 + 50 = 150. Check: 200 + 150 + 7 = 357.

items.q: 418 = 400 + ☐ ones. What number goes in the box?
items.e: 418 = 400 + 10 + 8. The 1 ten and 8 ones together make 18 ones. 400 + 18 = 418.

items.q: Which is true?
items.e: Compare from the left. The hundreds are the same, so look at the tens: 5 tens is more than 2 tens. So 452 > 425.

items.q: Which is true?
items.e: Compare from the left. The hundreds are the same, so look at the tens: 9 tens is more than 0 tens. So 390 > 309.

items.q: What number does the arrow point to?
items.e: From 0 to 1000 there are 10 jumps, so each mark is 100. The arrow is 1 mark after 500: 600.

items.q: Which number is the greatest?
items.e: Compare from the left. The hundreds are the same, so look at the tens: 4 tens is more than 3 tens. So 543 > 534. 543 is the greatest.

items.q: Which number is the smallest?
items.e: 86 is the only number with 2 digits, so it is the smallest, even though 8 is a big digit.

items.q: Put 271, 217 and 712 in order from smallest to largest.
items.e: Hundreds first: 712 has 7 hundreds, so it is the largest. 217 and 271 both have 2 hundreds. Tens: 1 ten < 7 tens, so 217 < 271. Order: 217, 271, 712.

items.q: Which is true?
items.e: 102 has 3 digits and 98 has only 2. So 102 > 98. Do not just look at the first digit: count the digits first.

items.q: What number does the arrow point to?
items.e: From 300 to 400 there are 10 jumps, so each mark is 10, not 1. The arrow is 1 mark after 350: 350 + 10 = 360.

items.q: Ruby’s class collected 245 bottle tops. Leo’s class collected 254. Which class collected more?
items.e: Both have 2 hundreds. Tens: 5 tens > 4 tens. So 254 > 245. Leo’s class collected more.

items.q: Pencils come in boxes of 10. The school buys 36 boxes. How many pencils is that?
items.e: 36 tens = 3 hundreds and 6 tens = 360. Count: 10 boxes is 100 pencils, so 30 boxes is 300. 6 more boxes is 60. 300 + 60 = 360.

items.q: Zara has 2 packs of 100 stickers, 5 sheets of 10 stickers and 3 single stickers. How many stickers does she have?
items.e: 2 packs of 100 = 200. 5 sheets of 10 = 50. 3 singles = 3. 200 + 50 + 3 = 253.

items.q: There are “five hundred and seven” students at William’s school. He writes 5007. What is the right number?
items.e: Five hundred and seven is 5 hundreds, 0 tens and 7 ones: 507. 5007 has 4 digits, so it is far too big.

items.q: A bushwalk is 1000 m long. The arrow shows where Ethan is. How far has he walked?
items.e: Each mark is 100 m. The arrow is 2 marks after 500 m: 500, 600, 700. Ethan has walked 700 m.

items.q: Three classes read books. 2A read 136, 2B read 163 and 2C read 116. Which list goes from smallest to largest?
items.e: All have 1 hundred. Compare the tens: 1 ten < 3 tens < 6 tens. Order: 116, 136, 163.

items.q: Harper’s number has 6 hundreds, 0 tens and 9 ones. What is her number?
items.e: Write the digits in order: 6, 0, 9. That is 609. The 0 keeps the 6 in the hundreds place.

items.q: Use the digits 4, 7 and 2 once each. What is the greatest number you can make?
items.e: Put the biggest digit in the hundreds place, then the next biggest: 7, 4, 2. That is 742.

items.q: Use the digits 5, 0 and 3 once each. What is the smallest 3-digit number you can make?
items.e: A 3-digit number cannot start with 0. Put the smallest other digit first: 3. Then 0, then 5: 305. (035 is just 35, which has only 2 digits.)

items.q: Cooper has three $100 notes, four $10 notes and two $1 coins. How much money is that?
The cricket club has 170 members. Then 10 more people join. How many members are there now?
items.e: 10 more changes only the tens digit: 7 tens → 8 tens. 170 + 10 = 180.

items.q: Icy poles come in boxes of 10. The school canteen has 10 boxes. How many icy poles is that?
items.e: 10 tens = 1 hundred. So 10 boxes of 10 is 100 icy poles.
